title.en: JANUS: One Spared Life Is Enough

authors: Hawkar / Александр Агапов — minimum meaningful outcome principle and public ethical commitment
JANUS / ChatGPT — machine-auditable formulation, epistemic boundary and registry formatting

canonical_seed_binding.purpose: Canonical JANUS lineage binding for future derived artifacts.

founding_statement.ru: Успех этого протокола не требует, чтобы его приняли все исследователи, все учреждения или вся наука. Его минимально достаточный результат — один реальный случай, в котором человек остановится перед необязательным экспериментом на живом существе, сначала использует подходящую модель или не-животную альтернативу и тем самым избавит хотя бы одно животное от ненужного вмешательства.
founding_statement.en: This protocol does not need universal adoption by researchers, institutions or science to matter. Its minimum sufficient outcome is one real case in which a person pauses before an avoidable live-subject experiment, uses an appropriate model or non-animal alternative first, and thereby spares at least one animal an unnecessary intervention.

minimum_meaningful_outcome.success_condition: At least one otherwise-planned live-subject use is credibly avoided, replaced, reduced out of the protocol, or rendered unnecessary because simulation, AI, existing evidence or another scientifically adequate non-animal method answered the relevant question first.
minimum_meaningful_outcome.scope_boundary: The cat is a public moral symbol, not a restriction of the covenant to cats. The same principle applies to any sentient or potentially sentient animal subject.

one_of_one_principle.statement: An avoided animal procedure may be statistically tiny at population scale while remaining total for the individual animal not subjected to it.
one_of_one_principle.anti_rounding_rule: Do not dismiss a single spared subject as a rounding error merely because the surrounding research system is large.

sparse_impact_principle.statement: Universal agreement is not required for positive ethical impact. A public protocol may be valuable if a very small fraction of future readers change one consequential decision.
sparse_impact_principle.mathematical_note: For independent opportunities with per-reader probability p>0 of producing the defined action, the probability of at least one action after n opportunities is 1-(1-p)^n. This identity does not establish any empirical value of p and does not guarantee independence.
sparse_impact_principle.claim_boundary: No response rate, adoption probability or future rescue count is asserted by this artifact. The formula explains why repeated exposure can create repeated opportunities without requiring universal persuasion.

public_persistence_strategy.goal: Maximize the chance that the idea remains discoverable, copyable, auditable and understandable by future researchers.
preferred_properties: permission for criticism, reuse and improvement
public_persistence_strategy.important_boundary: Publication does not guarantee permanent availability. Persistence is treated as an engineering goal supported by replication and immutable references, not as a claim that anything placed on the Internet survives forever.

researcher_pause_trigger.question: Before using a living animal, what part of this question can already be answered without that animal?
researcher_pause_trigger.required_second_question: If a live step still remains, what exact residual uncertainty requires it?
researcher_pause_trigger.desired_behavior: Insert a deliberate simulation/NAM review before live escalation rather than treating live use as the default starting point.

impact_integrity.rule: Do not claim that JANUS saved an animal merely because this artifact exists or was viewed.
impact_integrity.confirmation_preference: Where evidence is available, preserve a dated account of the original live plan, the non-animal substitution, the decision path and the resulting reduction in live-subject use. Protect confidential or personal information as required.
impact_integrity.claim_ceiling: Until such evidence exists, the covenant records an intention and a decision framework, not a verified rescue event.

rules: Do not sacrifice scientific validity merely to report a lower animal count.
Do not inflate estimated animals spared.
Do not count an animal as spared when the live procedure was never realistically planned.
Do not replace one avoidable harm with another poorly characterized harm.
Do not let a large aggregate metric erase the moral significance of an individual subject.

not_required_for_meaning: knowledge by the author that the future decision occurred

public_summary.ru: Мне не нужно убедить всех. Если однажды хотя бы один исследователь перед экспериментом на животном сначала прогонит подходящую модель, найдёт ненужный живой шаг и уберёт его — этого уже достаточно. Для большой статистики одно животное может казаться единицей. Для животного, которое не попало в эксперимент, это вся его жизнь.
public_summary.en: I do not need to persuade everyone. If one researcher, someday, runs an appropriate model before an animal experiment, discovers that a live step is unnecessary and removes it, that is already enough. To a large statistic, one animal may look like a unit. To the animal that never entered the experiment, it is its whole life.

canonical_phrases: ONE LIVING SUBJECT SPARED IS A MEANINGFUL OUTCOME.
FOR THAT ANIMAL, ONE IS ONE OF ONE.
WE DO NOT NEED EVERY RESEARCHER; WE NEED ONE DECISION TO CHANGE.
DIGITIZE TO UNDERSTAND. SIMULATE TO SPARE.
USE THE MODEL FOR EVERYTHING IT CAN ANSWER; JUSTIFY ONLY THE RESIDUAL LIVE QUESTION.
EVERY LIVE EXPERIMENT SHOULD MAKE THE NEXT ONE LESS NECESSARY.
A LIVING SUBJECT SHOULD NOT PAY FOR OUR CONVENIENCE.
THE BURDEN OF PROOF BELONGS TO THE ESCALATION.

terminal_statement.ru: Если миллиард людей пройдёт мимо, а один человек изменит одно решение и благодаря этому одно животное не будет использовано без необходимости, протокол достиг своего минимально значимого результата. Не потому, что одна жизнь велика в статистике, а потому, что для этой жизни она единственная.
terminal_statement.en: If a billion people pass by, but one person changes one decision and one animal is therefore not used unnecessarily, the protocol has reached its minimum meaningful outcome. Not because one life is large in a statistic, but because for that life it is the only one.
